text:
Maya: Odd bug in edge sample: after ESM bundling Authorization header becomes undefined, SDK retries. CJS build fine.
Jun: can you paste minimal repro & tsconfig/bundler?
Maya: tiny repro: `client.call('/x', { auth: token, headers:{'x':'1'} })` tsconfig: module=ESNext, target=ES2022, importsNotUsedAsValues=remove, esModuleInterop=true. esbuild with minify=true.
Maya: bundle output snippet: ```export function call(u,o){o=o||{};const h=o.headers||{}; /* o.auth gone */ }```
Priya: smells like a type-only overload or generic got erased and bundler treeshook a tiny forwarding helper. `unknown` vs `any` in conditional types can influence emit.
Jun: quick try: set `importsNotUsedAsValues=preserve` (or TS5 `preserveValueImports=true`) and disable minify. does repro go away?
Maya: yes, preserveValueImports=true + minify=false fixes it locally.
Priya: workaround for samples: prefer named imports, avoid d.ts-only overloads on exported runtime wrappers, or make the runtime param `options: Record<string, any>` so bundlers see the value.
Jun: follow-up: add a small CI check that compiles + bundles the minimal sample and asserts `opts.auth` exists in emitted JS. if SDK d.ts shapes are causing it, we should change the export to include a non-type-only shim.
CI-Bot: CI: edge-import-form-auth-repro #1 failed on node 20 (bundle shows missing Authorization) :warning:
